sections.title: Sound of letter ixe
paragraphs: The letter name is (ixe) /iks/. Its main sound is heard in (texte) /tɛkst/, which means text. This letter has several different pronunciations across French words. It can also produce no sound at all.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: For the first sound, stop the air with the back of your tongue. Release it into a hiss without voice. For the next sound, make that stop and hiss while your vocal cords vibrate. Put your hand on your throat to feel the buzz. For the third sound, blow air through your teeth without any throat buzz. The silent letter needs no mouth movement.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: Inside words, this letter makes the sound in (texte) /tɛkst/. After initial e before a vowel, it sounds like (examen) /ɛɡ.za.mɛ̃/. At the end of most words, it is a silent letter, as in (paix) /pɛ/. In a few counting words, it sounds like (dix) /dis/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pronounce the silent letter at the end of words like (deux) /dø/. English words like box always say the end sounds. Leave your mouth completely quiet at the end instead.
